description: The plot illustrates the relationship between the number of reasoning steps and the Pass@1 Rate for two models, GPT-4o and another model represented by a gray line, although the gray line is not labeled. The x-axis is labeled "Num. of Reasoning Steps" with a linear scale, ranging from 5 to 40, with tick labels at 5, 10, 20, and 40. The y-axis is labeled "Pass@1 Rate (%)" with a linear scale, ranging from 0 to 100, with tick labels at intervals of 20. The GPT-4o model is represented by a blue line with circle markers and a solid line style, starting at 6.5% at 5 reasoning steps and increasing to 83.9% at 40 reasoning steps, with notable increases to 32.3% at 10 steps and 77.4% at 20 steps. The other model is represented by a light blue line with cross markers and a solid line style, starting at 19.4% at 5 reasoning steps and increasing to 89.2% at 40 reasoning steps, with notable increases to 38.7% at 10 steps and 87.1% at 20 steps.
